test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BOSE’ is coded as ‘4303810’, and ‘SPY’ is coded as ‘383250’. How will ‘URANUS’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/xgPrsywGrF38K5OT1YXCX5YCxcEIQzS-iiXf7OP9MY0JTovCKrNZ3W3NkMdn1Y6pRB1d9BSHInyKAXoz5-Cuu1V4y-KaIEPzxthVPJ20CKBdNwt2gu3cjhTPzpbiR-jmpk7ba2y5t9DaNvKO6w] 

Logic: Every alphabet is multiply with 2.

'BOSE' is coded as '4303810'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e45f71f1cd394e6286d90368e884547715bb4a99a90eda9d632d5e4dabf1aeee.png] 

And,

'SPY' is coded as '383250'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/737c68a039cef6456787094063b080a583cc9bd51577ed6bbc7e4a23681cafd7.png] 

Similarly,

'URANUS' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98860cfd0d854e162f9a84d7500c8af58c41fbc6067a2c33165f6a2e0770e808.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "42362284238".
